reviews.text: 作为之前特别好评的《原点计划》的续作，本作一改其类吸血鬼幸存者游戏的玩法，将其变为了暗黑刷宝类型的游戏。而改变之后的游戏玩法则采用了和前作相同的器官、基因等内容构筑起来的庞大build体系，同时游戏还设计了多达五个章节供玩家去不断挑战收集不同的器官，组成自己独特的build去挑战boss。但是稍显遗憾的是游戏关卡制的设定导致游戏场地太小，同时boss过大的碰撞体积略微影响游戏体验。 太长不看版购买指南 特别好评类吸血鬼幸存者游戏的续作 暗黑刷宝类游戏 关卡有些小，敌人的碰撞体积稍显不合理 [h1]从类吸血鬼到暗黑刷宝，《原点计划》还能特别好评吗？[/h1] 从几年前《吸血鬼幸存者》发售开始，此类游戏便开始如雨后春笋般冒出，而炮开大部分直接照搬前者套路的有游戏之外，还是有着一些此类游戏精品，而《原点计划》就是其中之一，这款作品凭借着完全区别于其他类吸血鬼幸存者游戏的build体系而吸引了诸多玩家，并且游戏的评价也非常的出色，但是遗憾的是因为发行商的原因游戏遗憾下架，成为了绝版收藏。而更换了内容框架，却塞的一摸一样的馅料的暗黑玩法的《原点计划》还能好玩吗？ 从本质上来说本作的通过基因和不同的器官组成的庞大build内容为这款暗黑玩法的作品贡献了非常多的内容，但是遗憾的是游戏前期的爽快度却因为需要玩家一次次刷关卡获得基因和器官的设定而大大延长，而游戏相对应的一些问题也随着玩法的改变而暴漏出来，其中问题最大的部分就是游戏的碰撞体积设计，游戏中的关卡相较于前作中的地图变得更加的小，玩家的移动范围也因此而缩减，而配合上boss庞大的体积，你会发现游戏稍显粗糙的碰撞设定成为了游戏体验的最大阻碍。 但是你并不能因此说这款游戏不好玩，游戏将其中的build模块单拎出来之后，游戏中玩家可以更加自由的搭配不同的器官和基因，组成自己觉得最强的build去挑战一个个不同的boss，其可玩性也随之增加。 [h1]结语[/h1] 值得一试的刷子类游戏，但是仍有一些细节问题要解决。 评分8/10 [quote] 游玩百态，将游玩心得用汉语化作玩家的指明灯，(๑•̀ㅂ•́)و✧ [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/35402408/]点击这里关注汉化语录~[/url] 如果喜欢这个评测，请点个赞让更多人看见 [/quote]

A fantastic sequel that expands on the original. Tons more polish, and even a story! EDIT: Be advised that there is a step change in enemy stats at the boss of the third level. You can beat him if you use mutations to add projectiles to organs and multiply your damage; unlike the original you need to add vessels and other modifiers yourself in the lab. And it is also possible to farm earlier levels with a difficulty bonus (bottom left) to increase the rewards.

第一时间购入的，也玩过一代，Demo也玩了。玩法没话说，有趣程度和想象力成正比。但是这个首发版本问题太大了。 缺点： 1.数值：话说这游戏数值是不是没调好，第三章boss血量太多了，刮半天。前期给的器官数值真的低。 2.构筑：这个是真的难绷，我理解变成刷子游戏后，需要不断刷器官，不能一下把器官给玩家，但是你前三章都是什么狗史器 官，太踏马难组成BD了吧，以子嗣流为例，首先好一点子嗣很难获得不说，肺也难拿，你马的前三章能用的“腹”只有 毒和那个割 的，而且毒囊是删除了可以无限叠层的毒囊吗？4点伤害的一层毒都有什么用？ 器官占用量为什么要改？一个器官普遍占用2个位置，我拿什么来构筑？怎么构筑？我是要玩着爽，不是畏手畏脚的玩 高级器官普遍占用3个位置，怎么玩，我是用还是不用？ 3.资源：太肝了，相比于一代只有一种资源，这游戏有踏马3种，真的难绷，两种还是稀缺资源，我肝个蛋，老子是来玩游戏 的不是来上班的。 总结：未来可期，等更新。

Call me Frankenstein cus ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ I'm giggling like a mad scientist playing around with my body parts like it's nobody's business! Edit with actual review: After finishing the game, I can comfortably say its a great game. I'm a little bummed out that it was super short (I want to cause more mayhem with my build), but for this price, it was an amazing experience. Builds can go crazy wild and I was super proud of myself in making a broken build that lets me clear all content while standing still. However, it seemed like not everybody shared the same experience as me, which is fine but to those who are not recommending it because the bosses are HARD is just strange to me. The whole point of the game is to optimize your build so of course the build you run with for clearing waves of little critters doesn't work with a boss that has a large health pool and attacks that actually hurt. Granted, there might be a better way to transition the players into the difficulty spike like a difficulty setting. However, we get misinformation spread like there's only one or two builds who can defeat a boss or that there's too much RNG and you have to grind a long long time to make said build. If you are doing fine already on regular rooms, you can clear entire levels in 2-3 minutes. Rewards can also be scaled with risk and levels so grinding for stuff isn't hard. If you're talking about RNG in getting mutations you want, there's potions that can remove mutations and there's higher level potions you can craft by selling extra other unnecessary potions to reroll attributes, or removing the worst mutation. I rarely had to go out of my way to grind for extra organs because potions make life so much easier already. And if you do need extra organs, you can reroll for it in the battery shop. I do prefer if the rerolling was a bit cheaper, but other than that, I never felt frustrated towards the game. Changing up your build to adapt to different occasions is exactly what's fun about it. As of today, the devs have nerfed boss health and even made many upgrades cheaper. So if you're interested, please give the game a try and if you're still struggling, feel free to experiment or ask the community.

It doesn't do anything new or better than its predecessor aside from more meta progression. just slightly reskinned attacks. In this game we have a Sasquatch Arm slam down. In the old game it was a Bone Arm. The maps are basically small squares. Every single one of them. Basically you end up spamming a map over and over. And like i said earlier, they're just small square maps. You choose an elevator and either kill waves, survive a timer, kill an elite or stand on an objective. Spam repeat the maps to target Replica organs and currencies for meta progression. After awhile its just boring and RNG crafting can get frustrating if you're not getting what you need. Especially since the game DPS checks you really hard on the 3rd boss.

This is not the best game on steam. It's not even in the top ten I've ever played. But Bioweaver, and its counterpart Bio Prototype, are both really really good games. The original game, Bio Prototype (BP for short) was essentially Vampire Survivors with a twist. Level-based 30 minute action where you progressively grow stronger and stronger until you die, then restart. Bioweaver (BW for short) took that concept and changed it significantly. Now, you are simply playing a game like Path of Exile where you progressively grow stronger and stronger by gaining infinite new organs, mutating them into slightly stronger and slightly superior versions of old ones, making complex builds to mow through enemies that can be drastically scaled up in power as needed to give even better organs and better stats, so on and so forth. This game's organ-building system is extremely complex and fun to delve into. Even just grinding and seeing new organs constantly dropping from enemies gives me a constant burst of dopamine. I played 30 hours in the highly restricted demo, and the actual full game is WAY better. I can't wait to play this at work in 5-10 minute bursts every lunch break. I am hopelessly addicted! It just keeps getting better and better the more I play! If you like autistic build-prepping a character to develop new powers and abilities through complex interactions, play BW. It is an utterly unique game unlike any I've played before. Well worth a measly $7, let alone nabbing it on a 30% sale like today!

《原点计划》之前曾经登录过Steam，但是受到原发行便当游戏的影响，被连带着一起下架了。如今游戏制作组没有再通过其他发行，而是自己发行了本作游戏。 《原点计划》的核心玩法是类幸存者似的2D肉鸽射击砍杀玩法，并且整体的系统更贴近于《土豆兄弟》，游戏的画面采用像素风格，并且有一定的血腥感，不过整体游戏还是老少皆宜的。 游戏的剧情讲述了在神秘的地下实验室中，原本在实验室中的各种危险生物逃逸了出来，玩家则需要与这些危险生物进行对抗，并通过吸收他们的器官改造自己的武器，从而突破艰难险阻一步步回到地面上来。 游戏的核心玩法是比较传统的类幸存者玩法，每个关卡的通关条件，要么是存活相应的时间，要么是消灭地图上的所有敌人，部分关卡包含boss战，玩家需要消灭boss后方可通关。游戏的难度是层层递进的，玩家只有通关了前面较低难度的关卡后才可以开放更高难度的关卡。随着主线剧情的推进，玩家面临的怪物难度会越来越大，敌人的生命值和攻击倾向也会越来越高，自适应的难度带给玩家更高的新鲜感，从而不断挑战自己的上限。 游戏拥有较为创新的玩法，其中最主要的部分是器官改造，玩家可以在关卡中通过击杀敌人来拾取可能随机掉落的各种器官，在通关关卡后也有可能获得的奖励中也包含一些改造器官。玩家将这些器官用在自己的武器上，从而改变自己的攻击方式。游戏中器官的种类比较多，并且每个器官还有可能会有额外的词条或者连接点。玩家需要通过刷刷刷的玩法来拾取更多种类的器官，为自己搭配合适的BD。通过升级实验室来获得更高的点数，连接更多的器官。而只有携带连接点的器官才可以在后面继续延续安装其他的器官。除去器官改造玩法之外，玩家还可以在实验室中使用其他的物品来提升各种战斗能力和自己的属性，基本上游戏中提升玩家战斗能力的都是局外成长部分，因为战斗时间较短，所以局内成长很少。玩家通过不断的挑战关卡，升级实验室来不断的提升自己的战斗实力。部分关卡并不只是一层，当清理完当前层后，可以通过选择不同奖励的门来前往下一层，这样在战斗结束后可以获得不同的关卡奖励，方便玩家选择合适的目标来进行挑战。 本作游戏看上去缝合了很多的内容，但就像《无主之地》那样，虽然词条的搭配组合较多，但是玩到后期还是会感觉有些重复，可能会为了某一个词条不断的刷。好在游戏的价格较为低廉，所以整体性价比较高。如果对这种类幸存者玩法的游戏感兴趣的玩家建议尝试一下这款创新玩法的作品。 [quote]点击关注「 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/41448772//]三言两语评测」→ [/url]简洁的语言，实用的内容 [/quote]

It's about ten hours of content to beat the game and complete the 30-floor challenge mode, or a few hours less if you land on a busted build. The translation's kinda jank so there were times I was wondering what various mechanics or powers actually did. The fact that all of your brains are active simultaneously should really be explained better at the beginning. Overall, pretty fun while it lasts if you like experimenting with weird game interactions and going "I wonder if this works?" But once you win the game by making a build that deletes everything, it runs out of content pretty fast. The interesting part of the game is farming up organs and the relatively low capacity per brain limits how much wacky interaction-chaining you can actually do. Not to mention that there are a few replica organs that are just obviously superior once you understand how they work. Still, the game isn't shy about actually paying off good builds by letting you steamroll levels so it's entertaining once you figure it out.

[h1]《原点计划2》：别再叫我「类Noita」，老子现在是POE！[/h1] 《原点计划》是我相当喜欢的一部类幸存者作品，坦白说在这浩如烟海的幸存者大军里，我甚至可以把它排到一个T1级别的位置——T0大概只能是《土豆兄弟》跟《吸血鬼幸存者》本身了。这主要是因为在“缝合换皮当道”的类幸存者作品中，《原点计划》将《女巫Noita》的核心玩法跟类幸存者结合，确实给我带来了非常新鲜的构筑体验——而作为幸存者最重要的维度之一可能就是「构筑爽」，这点来说《原点计划》完成的相当不错。 不过在最新的《原点计划2》中，游戏的底层玩法有了些大刀阔斧地变革：[b]核心仍旧是名为「器官」实为法术链条的技能编组，但是对游戏的体验却从一个类幸存者游戏变成了一个有点“暗黑like”的刷刷刷游戏。[/b]要是你对《流放之路》（Path of exile，以下简称POE）这部作品有所了解，那你对于2代的变化就不会感到奇怪了，毕竟连《女巫Noita》的玩法核心也是从POE的技能组框架上衍变而来的！ 简单来说呢，[b]《原点计划2》的最大变化大概是丢掉了类幸存者的框架，而是转为传统的刷刷刷——个中的区别，在于「构筑是否可保留」。[/b]类幸存者的本质是肉鸽的基底，单局游戏内容不会保留，所以你这把可能是天胡爽局、下把可能就啥也没有。而暗黑like就不一样了，目标就是刷刷刷，只要你搭配出一个强力BD就可以保留，之后不过是在这个方案上继续优化，甚至你自己觉得脑细胞不足还可以直接上网抄其他大神的！ 但这也对「装备」本身做出了相当高的要求。于是乎这代加入了另一个重大机制变动：[b]道具词条。[/b]前作中的基因基本上是没啥大变化，器官、流派的选择看起来也差不多，不过每个器官现在都有了词条，围绕这一机制又加入了道具系统，让玩家对词条有着更高的构筑自由度来打造心中的理想流派。 而在游戏的一些对局体验上，对于单局失败的挫败感会减少，反之兴许是为了拉长你的刷刷刷时间，游戏的BOSS设计似乎有着明显的数值阶梯——说人话就是构筑不如前作那般容易成型了。举个最简单的例子，在前作里「带血管的输出器官」浓度跟本作比起来要高太多， 而降低其出现频率也会限制玩家的输出上限，因为必须要有额外血管才能进一步放大输出。总之，我的游戏感受就是：[b]BOSS打不过了，那就再刷一会吧！[/b]刷到自己能打过为止，但奇特的是，本作似乎没有保留前作单纯的数值成长，转而替换成「基因」系统，用天赋的形式让玩家获得微弱的数值跟机制提升，这其实又不怎么暗黑like了——毕竟RPG里最重要的就是数值嘛。 有意思的是，游戏的前作算是一代类型存者神作，在圈子里有很高的评价，人气也相当高（虽然目前游戏下架商店页面被BAN，但印象里是有个几千条评价、90%+的好评率），而目前本作的评价却不高，我觉得根本原因还是在于核心玩法的转变：[b]因为肉鸽跟暗黑like是两种类型。[/b]喜欢肉鸽的有可能是喜欢随机性，享受每局里的构筑策略；而喜欢暗黑like的，则是享受刷刷刷的快乐，他们也许根本都不care构筑（毕竟可以直接抄），而是追逐「出货」的那种满足感。 所以这可能就是《原点计划2》所面临的问题了：[b]既然做出了一个违背组训的改动，是否还能挽回那些曾经的玩家呢？[/b] [quote] 执笔勾墨色，挥毫著文章；阳春布德泽，璞玉生光辉 欢迎关注[url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/44174077/]吟遊诗人的手札[/url]，书游戏特色，写游戏魅力 [/quote]

It's a mixed bag. If you liked Bio Prototype then you'll probably like this game too. If you didn't, stay away. I'd give it a so-so recommendation but steam only lets me give it a thumbs up or down. Here are some of my thoughts in detail: Pros: -Dirt cheap (bought it on sale for less than $5 and sunk at least 6 hours so far, worth it on cost basis alone IMO) -Experimentation with builds is still easy and interesting -Simple controls -Improved explanations of game mechanics compared to Bio Prototype -New meta progression gameplay loop with an alternative way to play with permadeath like a traditional roguelike -High replay value due to infinite stat upgrades and a huge variety of organs to collect -Less punishing of an experience than Bio Prototype -Not memory-intensive and runs alright even on a low end setup Cons: -Very repetitive gameplay -Uninteresting combat (all of my builds converge on standing in one place the whole time while only a few enemies at a time try to swarm my character) -New map format makes the game feel small -A lot of farming involved, very grindy upgrade system (limited number of modifications you can perform on each organ before you have to go farm new ones and character stat upgrade costs ramp up very quickly) -Smaller brain capacity puts a creative ceiling on character creation -No more choosing from a roster of unlockable unique characters, you will always start with the same blank slate -No multiplayer capabilities -Enemy art style lacks soul -Enemy hitboxes are still poorly mapped just like in Bio Prototype -Remains unclear whether or not the developer will actually continue working on the game like how they abandoned Bio Prototype after making big promises for workshop support and content updates

Don't buy this. There is a boss that's completely broken, fits nowhere with the rest of the game, and seemingly has no intent to be fixed. The boss has repeat invincibility phases with a timer tied to its pixel art and at the end of this deals 66% of your health instantly in damage that you can only dodge if you possess a single second invincibility power. Phase 2 combines this with unavoidable attacks with no prompting, and enemy units that never despawn and deal area damage that can make the entire room deal instantly lethal levels. Games with Hardcore modes should not have bosses this broken. Edit: Tried again after numerous patches, only to find they made existing builds worse and I instantly died despite there "totally being an immunity zone", avoid this game, do something better and more fun with your time like file taxes.

I really enjoy this game, but be warned--it is not for low IQ gamers. There are a lot of systems to work with, and, if you can figure them out, you'll be able to create some very interesting builds for your character. Some of the systems feel very reminiscent of Path of Exile in a good way. The loot is fun and grinding to find and craft just the right parts for a build gives good dopamine hits. If I had to say something negative I would say that the actual combat could use more depth. I can barely tell the different monster types apart, and there's only a few different rooms types for you to fight in. Overall very good and worth the price if you like games that give you a lot of build depth.

[i] Currently the most inclusive game on Steam, allowing you to mix and match your identity on the fly. Kudos to the dev for catering to the ‘woke’ demographic! [/i] [h1]📝 Main Pros, Cons, and Suggestions:[/h1] 🟩 Pros: + Constant updates + Diablo-esque loot system + Near infinite stat upgrades + Meta progress through DNA (gene) manipulation + Saving, sharing, and importing builds allows for plenty of build experimentation + A variety of upgradable organs (skills) which visually changes your character (similar to Spore) 🟥 Cons: - Highly repetitive - Rooms feel too small - Poor UI/UX in the organ screen - Upgrading organs is RNG based - Large focus on grind may put some off (costs increase exponentially) 🏷️ Suggestions: ~ Additional blob types (different colours), each focusing on different playstyles [h1] Do not be discouraged my child, my gift to you is to live again[/h1] Bioweaver (BW) is a survivor like with a twist – you create a one-of-a-kind character that’s uniquely yours. Playing as a slime, you’ll equip organs and mutate genes to unlock skills and abilities. As my character evolved from a simple pink slime to a gorilla armed beast with bunny like ears and dragonfly wings, I was reminded of Spore - it’s a winning formula. The best part of BW is the vast organ system, allowing you to mix and match freely to your hearts content (within your brains capacity). The mutation system adds tiered modifiers (T0 – T5) to organs, allowing you to keep upgrading them as long as they’ve durability. The downside is the RNG nature of upgrades, which could frustrate many. While I enjoy RNG loot and upgrades in RPGs, I didn’t enjoy having limited control over upgrades in a VS like. In saying that, if you enjoy the genre, BW is a must try. It’s affordable, offers a decent amount of content, and provides unmatched character freedom. Designing your character from scratch is expensive, but oh so rewarding – GIve the demo a try!
